commit_message:
Extract metrics TUI from xtask to tools/metrics-tui

Move the ratatui/crossterm TUI dependencies out of xtask into a separate
tool crate. This speeds up xtask compilation for users who just want to
run simple commands like `cargo xtask bench` or `cargo xtask schema`.

The `cargo xtask metrics` command now delegates to `cargo run -p metrics-tui --release`.

Fixes #1329
